name: Kaden Priebe
intro: i want to ground myself intellectually in public. this is that. i am lowing the barrier to entry to write; this is to express myself, not to put forth super polished work. please email me and provide pushback or if u just resonate with the ideas and wanna meet. I also think it is worth noting here that I am accumulation of all the media and interactions that I have consumed and been in. i will aim to give credit when credit is due but cannot always because i am indebted to the wisdom of those who came before me.
